description: Execute Codex CLI with file analysis (@syntax), skills ($syntax), model selection, and safety controls. Supports changeMode.

addDirs.description: Additional writable directories beyond workspace (e.g., ["/tmp", "/var/log"]). Useful for monorepos and multi-directory projects.

approval.description: Deprecated alias for approvalPolicy — both map to --ask-for-approval. Prefer approvalPolicy. Values: on-request, never

bypassHookTrust.description: DANGEROUS: run enabled hooks without persisted hook trust

changeMode.description: Return structured OLD/NEW edits for refactoring

config.description: Configuration overrides as 'key=value' string or object

disableFeatures.description: Disable feature flags (repeatable). Equivalent to -c features.<name>=false

enableFeatures.description: Enable feature flags (repeatable). Equivalent to -c features.<name>=true

ephemeral.description: Run without persisting Codex session files to disk

fullAuto.description: Compatibility alias for workspace-write with approval=never (not --yolo)

ignoreRules.description: Ignore user and project execpolicy .rules files for this run

ignoreUserConfig.description: Ignore $CODEX_HOME/config.toml for this run; authentication is still loaded

image.description: Optional image file path(s) to include with the prompt

localProvider.description: Specify which local provider to use (lmstudio or ollama). Automatically enables --oss if not set. If omitted with --oss, uses config default or shows selection.

model.description: Optional model override. Known: gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-astra, gpt-6-sol, gpt-6-luna, gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.5. If omitted, uses your Codex CLI default (~/.codex/config.toml). Specify only to override.

oss.description: Use local Ollama server (convenience for -c model_provider=oss). Requires Ollama running locally. Automatically sets sandbox to workspace-write if not specified.

outputLastMessage.description: Write final Codex message to file path. Useful for CI/CD result capture (Codex CLI v0.95.0+)

outputSchema.description: JSON Schema path or inline schema to constrain output format (Codex CLI v0.95.0+)

personality.description: Communication style: pragmatic (concise, machine-friendly) or friendly (conversational). Codex CLI v0.94.0+

prompt.description: Task or question. Use @ to include files (e.g., '@largefile.ts explain').

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning depth. Omit to use the CLI default. max/ultra are model-dependent GPT-6/GPT-5.6 options; ultra may delegate to subagents.

resetSession.description: Clear session context before execution. Starts fresh conversation.

responseMode.description: Response verbosity: "clean" returns only the final answer (default), "full" returns the complete execution log including thinking, tool calls, and agent activity

sandbox.description: Quick automation mode: enables workspace-write with approval=never. Sandboxing remains active.

search.description: Enable web search using native --search flag (v0.52.0+). Requires network access - automatically sets sandbox to workspace-write if not specified.

sessionId.description: Session ID for conversation continuity. Enables native Codex resume.

skipGitRepoCheck.description: Skip git repository validation. Useful for non-git directories (Codex CLI v0.75.0+)

strictConfig.description: Fail when config.toml contains fields unknown to the installed Codex CLI

toolOutputTokenLimit.description: Maximum tokens for tool outputs (100-10,000). Controls response verbosity.

name: ask-codex
